source_claim: AlphaEvolve paper-facing benchmark claims require scoped fixtures, expert formulation, task targets, repeated-seed evidence, baseline values, emitted result artifacts, and anti-gaming checks
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has runtime readiness telemetry for example-scope registry linkage, smoke fixture scope, formulation/review metadata, task-spec identity, and benchmark hardening references when present. A checked four-seed matrix fixture records known rank-7/rank-8 baselines and emitted traces, but does not claim non-smoke AlphaEvolve-comparable fixture scope, search-derived repeated-seed results, anti-gaming negative-fixture checks for a full benchmark, or paper-claim-ready benchmark fixtures.
